title: heterocentron hirtellum
intro: Heterocentron hirtellum, commonly known as "Gentle Dog's Tail", is a plant species within the family Melastomataceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Heterocentron hirtellum include analgesic, antiseptic, and antipyretic effects, which may help alleviate pain, infections, and fever. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, although more research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological properties.
